Census at s411: 462 clusters / ~4 300 deletable lines over 52 files.

ORDER (§3): 1 family 6 run_isolated -> tools/lib/PCLProc.pm (runners row: each runner once, verdicts file-identical, PCL_SHOW_SBCL=1 before/after); 2 family 5 _decl_syms_under (8 copies; full sweep); 3 family 34 TokenUtils is_*_braces collapse in place (176 k calls — no shared sub); 4 families 3, 4, 8 PExpr::parse/handle_subcalls mechanics (one helper per commit, corpus-diff each, the term-maze rule: no behaviour change); 5 families 17, 20, 44 ExprToCL cold helpers; 6 Lisp 23 define-slow-binop, 13 p-array-fill/p-copy-array flet, 21 %p-flatten-slice-keys, 37 %p-extend-to, 42/46-48 symref prologue + p-setf macrolets (sweep + bench each; tools/check-parens.lisp after every edit); 7 after Phase A (#384): families 2+10 (_elem_container_key in gen_funcall_form) and 14/26 (_expr_compiler in Parser.pm).  Re-run the census after each plan phase lands; carry the verdict rules, not the numbers.

The extraction found and fixed #397 and the empty-slice arity split (delete @a[()] crashed on arity) plus its runtime twin (three of the four slice-delete runtimes answered 0, not undef, for an empty slice); it also filed #396. DONE s414 (Opus).  The EXTRACT half of the worklist is complete under the s413 scope ruling (compiler + runtime only).  s414 landed: families 2+10 (d33c5a1, ExprToCL::_elem_container_key, 201 -> 62), 14+26 (225483e, Parser.pm _expr_parser/_expr_generator), 38 (6fa946e, InterpScan::_name_event -- FOUR copies, not the two the census counted), and one family that fell out of the pass, the &-mention arms of exists/defined/undef (d4b86d8, _amp_sub_name + the existing _amp_cast_operand_id).  Each corpus-diff IDENTICAL, emission-ab 23/23 SAME, gate green; the two commits that touched cl/pcl-runtime.lisp also ran a full sweep (GATE clean, TOTAL 18513 +0, drops 13 = census).

THE TAIL RULE IS SATISFIED: tools/dup-census.pl --min-lines 8 over Pl/** + cl/pcl-runtime.lisp now leaves SIX EXACT runs, every one in code with a standing verdict -- four in Parser.pm's _process_block / _process_block_in_tail_context / _process_scheduled_block / _process_local_declaration / _process_tail_stmt (LEAVE, DELETED-BY E5.3) and two in StringInterpolation.pm's subscript walkers (SUPERSEDED-BY #388, the InterpScan consumer-3 port).  Everything else is SHAPE-only.  Re-open only if a phase deletes those verdicts.

BUGS THE PASS FOUND (the census-as-bug-finder rule, four more on top of s413's three): #397 (tied/pos emitted a reference to the WRONG variable for a nested package-qualified index -- fixed), the empty-slice arity split (delete @a[()] CRASHED on arity -- fixed) and its runtime twin (three of the four slice-delete runtimes answered 0, not undef, for an empty slice -- fixed), `defined STDIN` reading FALSE because p-defined-fh resolved filehandles its own way (fixed, d4b86d8).  Filed for later: #396 (pos() on an element is always undef), #398 (perl's `defined BAREWORD` is not an openness test at all -- a decision, not a patch).
